scores.visual_critic_note: Tol palette and clean card grid show design intent, but 5 of 9 cells render blank in the screenshot due to staggered setTimeout delays — the gallery's primary purpose fails at its captured state.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: The stacked-bar morph target (demo 7) has a concrete encoding bug — segment height uses `h - y(d.val)` (full bar to baseline) instead of `y(d.cumY) - y(d.cumY + d.val)` (segment height), causing overlapping rects that misrepresent proportions; all other morphing demos are animation-focused with hardcoded domains but no additional deception.
scores.stress_test_note: No user interactions means update-storm, infinite-loop, and touch-fight risks are absent; tweenPts in initStarCircle interpolates from static point snapshots rather than current node state (unlike the correct arcTween pattern using this.__arcParams), making it brittle if ever interrupted mid-flight, and no .interrupt() calls are present anywhere.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 9-panel gallery with well-bounded cells and clear labels manages complexity well for a demo context, but 9 simultaneous looping animations (staggered 300ms) compete for attention and 6 of 9 cells appear blank in the screenshot — likely a staggered-init timing artifact rather than a rendering failure, but it undermines first-impression clarity.
